Read the fraction table from the BioRad NGC

Source: R/chrom_read.R
chrom_read_ngc_fractions.Rd

The NGC exports the fractions of a run as a .txt table, with the rack and tube each fraction was collected into and the volumes it covers.

Usage

chrom_read_ngc_fractions(file)

Arguments

file

File path to the .txt file.

Value

A tibble with a row for each fraction and the columns fraction, rack, tube, start, end and collected, the collected volume. fraction is a fraction vector, and the volumes are quantity vectors in mL. Like chrom_fractions(), it has the columns fraction, start and end.

Examples

fl <- system.file("extdata", "ngc_sec_fractions.txt", package = "chromr")
chrom_read_ngc_fractions(fl)
#> # A tibble: 21 × 6
#>    fraction rack   tube start  end collected
#>      <frac> <chr> <int>  <mL> <mL>      <mL>
#>  1        1 A         1  25.3 26.8      1.51
#>  2        2 A         2  26.8 28.3      1.49
#>  3        3 A         3  28.3 29.8      1.51
#>  4        4 A         4  29.8 31.3      1.5 
#>  5        5 A         5  31.3 32.8      1.49
#>  6        6 A         6  32.8 34.3      1.5 
#>  7        7 A         7  34.3 35.8      1.5 
#>  8        8 A         8  35.8 37.2      1.42
#>  9        9 A         9  61.6 63.0      1.5 
#> 10       10 A        10  63.0 64.6      1.5 
#> # ℹ 11 more rows
